The registry periodically issues a cryptographic puzzle requiring the private key of a hardware enclave to sign a fresh beacon before it can forge a valid transaction block. Every autonomous agent must embed its token within a unique jade security module during factory calibration. If an attacker attempts to spawn sybil nodes, each parallel instance forces an expensive sequential delay as it awaits the unpredictable beacon, driving CPU and electricity costs exponentially higher per fake identity. A single failed verification strips the associated sonnet.
